exclusion_reason: No installer extractor exists yet and the safe importer prerequisite is incomplete, so a supported installer cannot be unpacked to a payload without execution.
promotion_trigger: Promote when a supported Inno Setup, GOG, and InstallShield cabinet installer unpacks to the correct payload, a 16-bit setup stub is refused, and no installer code runs.
expected_failing_assertion: The extractor cannot unpack a supported installer to its reference payload without executing installer code.
active_gate_evidence: The product identifies a supported installer format and reports the extraction plan without unpacking or executing it.
procedure: Identify the installer format from overlay and sibling-file evidence.
Unpack a supported Inno Setup, GOG, or InstallShield cabinet fixture to a payload and refuse a 16-bit setup stub.
pass_criterion: Each supported installer fixture unpacks to the reference payload file set.
A 16-bit or unsupported installer is refused and no installer code is executed.
